mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 74 degrees with overcast skies over Reddan Soccer Park and the air quality is moderate with an index of 56.

City updates include phase two of the Aldi development road work beginning the week of September 7, which will shift traffic into the eastbound lanes on Highway M. Also, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward, with a bridge replacement near Lincoln Street closing that section of the trail from mid-September through mid-November.

Today is packed with activities, including the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness on September 7, trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on September 8, and the Downtown Farmer's Market along with Wednesday pizza at Lake Lou-ee on September 9.

The Verona Police Department reported the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison on September 4 regarding an inappropriate relationship with a student. The investigation began after the school district provided information on Sunday, August 30.
Culver's is serving up Mint Cookie as today's flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight.
